commands.name: CorrectTaskPlan
steps: pure-preflight require canonical task_id/current plan_revision_id UUIDv4 text, positive integer task_revision/current_plan_revision, complete positive-duration replacement schedule, bounded one-line nonempty reason_category (1..128 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL/CR/LF), lowercase 64-hex correction_review_fingerprint, and strict boolean accept_high_risk; convert local schedule via OBJECTIVE_TIMEZONE_V1 before writer lock

inside UoW load exact Task, task_plan_current and referenced immutable current plan; missing Task returns TASK_NOT_FOUND; task_revision, current_plan_revision, exact current plan_revision_id or same-Task ownership mismatch returns TASK_STALE before receipt/domain mutation

recompute SOMA_TASK_PLAN_CORRECTION_REVIEW_V1 from the exact current Task/current plan plus proposed replacement and the current explicit plan-lock projection, accepted execution projection/history, current outcome authority, current WFM source projection and same-source-revision terminal-review decision state when applicable, and current Objective membership/Objective/envelope/aggregate authority when applicable; projection/current rows that cannot be reconciled to required owned history fail closed as TASK_PLAN_LOCKED
exact-compare the recomputed correction review fingerprint with correction_review_fingerprint; any material authority or proposed-replacement change returns TASK_STALE before receipt/domain mutation

if replacement UTC interval and scheduling_timezone_iana exactly equal the current immutable plan return semantic NO_CHANGE after exact freshness/fingerprint proof with no receipt child, plan row, Task revision or audit event

if a pending wfm_source_terminal_review exists for the exact current WFM source_projection_revision return TASK_PLAN_LOCKED even when accept_high_risk=true; plan correction may not silently invalidate an active source-terminal consequence review

classify correction review risk as HIGH when current authority contains an explicit plan lock, accepted non-correction Task execution history, current accepted Task outcome, current terminal WFM source history, or protected current Objective history; otherwise LOW

when computed risk is HIGH require accept_high_risk=true or return TASK_PLAN_LOCKED before receipt/domain mutation; HIGH authorization is one reviewed correction only and does not clear an explicit lock or relax later mutations

append one immutable task_plan_revision with origin=correction, source_observation_id=null, predecessor_plan_revision_id equal to the exact prior current plan revision id, required reason_category, and accepted replacement interval/timezone; advance task_plan_current.revision exactly once and tasks.revision exactly once

preserve source-plan evidence, execution/outcome evidence, explicit lock history/state, and all Objective membership pins/envelopes; for mutable planned/current Objective context surface plan_membership_mismatch without replacing higher-priority attention, while terminal/historical/reviewed/superseded Objective membership, envelope and aggregate history remain frozen and expose mismatch only through derived read state

audit one task.plan_corrected.v1 event with exact prior/new plan refs, resulting Task revision, reason_category, computed LOW|HIGH risk and correction_review_fingerprint, commit, then request grouping recompute where current lifecycle remains eligible
rules: TaskPlanCorrectionPreview is the authoritative side-effect-free producer of correction_review_fingerprint; the command never accepts a caller-invented risk classification

SOMA_TASK_PLAN_CORRECTION_REVIEW_V1 binds the exact Task/current-plan freshness, proposed replacement interval/timezone, effective explicit lock authority, execution/outcome authority, applicable WFM source/terminal-review authority, and applicable Objective membership/envelope/aggregate authority used to classify this correction

correction is a governed one-time override of eligible plan locks, not an unlock: it never clears task_lock_projection, rewrites actual execution/outcome, changes provider source evidence, repins Objective membership, or rewrites Objective envelope/history
an active pending source-terminal consequence review is non-overridable by CorrectTaskPlan and must first be resolved or superseded by its owning source-terminal workflow
correction requires an existing current plan; Beta 1.0 defines no destructive plan-clear correction
correction preserves Task attempt identity; performing work again uses retry lineage and a new Task attempt instead
material correction advances tasks.revision and task_plan_current.revision exactly once; semantic NO_CHANGE advances neither
wall-clock passage alone never changes correction risk or fingerprint
completed report snapshots remain outside this mutation and are never rewritten
